name: st-georges-building
title: St George's Building
subtitle: Prime Freehold Mixed-Use Investment in Belfast City Centre
description: St George's Building is a prominent mid-terrace commercial building of traditional masonry construction with a mansard-style roof, designed in 1881 by Thomas Jackson and Son in Italianate style. The property is B1 listed and underwent extensive refurbishment in 2019. It extends to approximately 17,681 sq ft over ground, first, second, and third floors, comprising two retail/commercial units on the ground floor (2,508 sq ft) and 15,177 sq ft of office accommodation above. The second-floor office features the former 1960s boxing ring as a unique focal point. The building is fully let to two retail tenants and five office occupiers, with over 87% of income derived from offices. Key features include a WAULT of 3.96 years to lease expiry and 3.19 years to break, gross income of £284,500 per annum, and net income of £255,407 per annum. Over 72% of gross income is secured against tenants of minimum/low risk. The property is held freehold.
roi: Gross income £284,500 p.a.; Net income £255,407 p.a.; WAULT 3.96 years to expiry; Over 87% income from offices.
